hunks.baseline: Hunter Association.
hunks.sol: The Hunter Association.

hunks.baseline: The name had appeared some thirty years ago, at the same time the Great Cataclysm ended.
hunks.sol: The name had first appeared some thirty years ago, when the Great Cataclysm ended.

hunks.baseline: The first-generation Hunters who survived that blood-soaked catastrophe raised their flag, and over the years the Hunter Association grew into an organization of tremendous stature.
hunks.sol: The first-generation Hunters who survived that blood-soaked catastrophe raised their flag, and over the years, the Hunter Association grew into an organization of tremendous stature.

hunks.baseline: I swallowed as I stared up at the Association building standing tall before me. Even in this dense forest of skyscrapers, its size and height stood out. Even on an ordinary weekday, people streamed in and out.
hunks.sol: I swallowed as I stared up at the Association building towering before me. Its sheer size and height made it stand out even in this dense forest of skyscrapers. Though it was an ordinary weekday, countless people streamed in and out.

hunks.baseline: I was no different. The thought of twenty-year-old Jin Taekyung walking in here all excited almost made me snort—like hell it did.
hunks.sol: I was no different. Thinking of twenty-year-old Jin Taekyung walking in here with his heart full of excitement almost made me laugh—like hell it did.

hunks.baseline: I went into the lobby on stiff legs. The place was the size of a sports field and packed with people. I followed the electronic signs posted throughout until I found what I wanted.
hunks.sol: I entered the lobby on stiff legs. The place was the size of a playing field and packed with people. Following the electronic signs posted throughout the lobby, I found the place I wanted.

hunks.baseline: On the clerk’s instructions, I filled out the paperwork and went inside. Dozens of people were waiting to be measured.
hunks.sol: At the clerk’s instructions, I filled out the paperwork and went inside. Dozens of people were waiting to be measured.

hunks.baseline: The door shut, and everyone’s eyes shot into me like arrows.
hunks.sol: The door shut behind me, and every eye in the room stabbed into me like an arrow.

hunks.baseline: *Suffocating. This is suffocating.*
hunks.sol: *I can’t breathe. This is suffocating.*

hunks.baseline: Even the air was different here. A taut tension pressed down on the entire waiting room.
hunks.sol: Even the air felt different here. Tension hung over the entire waiting room.

hunks.baseline: *One measurement decides your whole Hunter life.*
hunks.sol: *One measurement could decide your entire career as a Hunter.*

hunks.baseline: I was no different. I’d been so nervous I’d even farted in front of an examiner once. That pretty much said it all.
hunks.sol: I was no exception. I’d once been so nervous that I farted in front of an examiner. That pretty much said it all.

hunks.baseline: I was waiting my turn, thinking about this and that, when—
hunks.sol: I was waiting my turn, lost in thought, when—

hunks.baseline: A familiar voice from behind me. I turned my head slowly.
hunks.sol: A familiar voice came from behind me. I slowly turned my head.

hunks.baseline: “I didn’t think it would be, but it is.”
hunks.sol: “I thought it might be you. Sure enough.”

hunks.baseline: A middle-aged man with a bulbous nose and a potbelly. A face I couldn’t forget no matter how hard I tried.
hunks.sol: A potbellied, middle-aged man with a bulbous nose. A face I couldn’t forget no matter how hard I tried.

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik. A founding member and team leader of Sopung Guild, where I’d spent years. He could be summed up in one word.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik. A founding member and team leader of Sopung Guild, where I’d spent several years.

hunks.baseline: Former boss.
hunks.sol: In short, my former boss.

hunks.baseline: “Wow, I never expected to run into you somewhere like this. Good to see you.”
hunks.sol: “Wow, I never expected to run into you here. Good to see you.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Kim thrust out his hand with a hearty laugh. I hesitated a moment, then took it.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Kim thrust out his hand with a hearty laugh. I hesitated for a moment, then shook it.

hunks.baseline: I’d said it thinking of Murim, but Team Leader Kim would hear something else. After all, he was the one who’d handed me my dismissal only a few days ago.
hunks.sol: I’d said it thinking of Murim, but Team Leader Kim would take it another way. After all, he was the one who’d handed me my dismissal only a few days ago.

hunks.baseline: “It’s because it’s summer. My days have felt long lately too.”
hunks.sol: “It’s the summer. My days have felt long lately too.”

hunks.baseline: Watching him slide past it like a sly old fox, I let out a hollow laugh.
hunks.sol: Watching him slip past the remark like a sly old fox, I let out a dry laugh.

hunks.baseline: He was a funny guy, no matter when you saw him.
hunks.sol: He was always an amusing man.

hunks.baseline: “Came to scout. Heard there was a decent one this time.”
hunks.sol: “Scouting. I heard there was a promising kid here today.”

hunks.baseline: They’d fired me for staff cuts in a restructuring. And he was here to scout.
hunks.sol: They’d supposedly fired me because restructuring required staff cuts, yet here he was scouting.

hunks.baseline: That was all I had to say. Everyone knew that tired story, and it was already over. I had no lingering attachment left.
hunks.sol: That was all I had to say. It was the same tired story everyone knew, and it was already over. I had no lingering attachment to it.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Kim spoke with a smile.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Kim smiled.

hunks.baseline: “Nice try, but isn’t that a waste of money? A reassessment isn’t cheap. Must be a burden for an F-rank Hunter.”
hunks.sol: “Nothing wrong with trying, but isn’t that a waste of money? Reassessments aren’t cheap. That must be a heavy expense for an F-rank Hunter.”

hunks.baseline: “Still, I figured I’d try. Just in case.”
hunks.sol: “I thought I’d give it a try anyway. Just in case.”

hunks.baseline: “You should save up while you’re young. What’s going to change if you keep clinging to something that isn’t going to work?”
hunks.sol: “You should save your money while you’re young. What’s going to change if you keep clinging to something that’ll never work?”

hunks.baseline: I smiled, gentle.
hunks.sol: I smiled gently.

hunks.baseline: A crack ran through Team Leader Kim’s smile.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Kim’s smile cracked.

hunks.baseline: “I said that’s enough. I’ve left the Guild now, so stay out of my business.”
hunks.sol: “I said that’s enough. I’m out of the Guild now, so stay out of my business.”

hunks.baseline: “You know what I mean.”
hunks.sol: “You know exactly what I mean.”

hunks.baseline: “It couldn’t be helped. You’re lucky you survived. Forget it all and make a fresh start. You pecked away at me behind my back while pretending to console me.”
hunks.sol: “All that ‘It couldn’t be helped,’ ‘At least you survived,’ and ‘Forget about it and make a fresh start.’ You pretended to comfort me while chipping away at me behind my back.”

hunks.baseline: “Weren’t you the one who first told the Guild Master to cut me? Did you think I wouldn’t know?”
hunks.sol: “Weren’t you the first one to tell the Guild Master to fire me? Did you think I wouldn’t find out?”

hunks.baseline: Short on humanity, short on ability.
hunks.sol: Short on both humanity and ability.

hunks.baseline: Even in Gates, he was too busy saving his own skin. His reputation in the Guild was rock-bottom.
hunks.sol: Even inside Gates, he was always too busy saving his own skin. His reputation within the Guild was rock-bottom.

hunks.baseline: “Who did you put in my place after you fired me? How much did you take to slot someone in?”
hunks.sol: “Who did you put in my place after firing me? How much did they pay you to get them in?”

hunks.baseline: “Hey. Jin Taekyung.”
hunks.sol: “Hey, Jin Taekyung.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Kim clamped down on my shoulder and growled. He didn’t look it, but he was one of only three D-rank Hunters in Sopung Guild. With that kind of strength, he could have toyed with an F-rank Hunter like me with one hand.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Kim pressed down on my shoulder and growled. He might not look it, but he was one of only three D-rank Hunters in Sopung Guild. With that kind of strength, he could toy with an F-rank Hunter like me using one hand.

hunks.baseline: “You little bastard. I’ve been putting up with you, but—”
hunks.sol: “You little bastard. I’ve let you get away with enough—”

hunks.baseline: The instant I grabbed Kim Sangshik’s wrist—
hunks.sol: The instant I seized Kim Sangshik’s wrist—

hunks.baseline: “Would the next group please come in. Numbers twenty-one through thirty!”
hunks.sol: “Would the next group please come in? Numbers twenty-one through thirty!”

hunks.baseline: An Association examiner walked in with a file, and we both let go before the other could. Getting marked by the Association wouldn’t do either of us any good.
hunks.sol: An Association examiner entered with a file in hand, and we sprang apart without waiting for the other to move first. Getting on the Association’s bad side wouldn’t do either of us any good.

hunks.baseline: “Who. Me? Or you?”
hunks.sol: “Who? Me, or you?”

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik’s flushed face looked downright ridiculous. Even the Level Window I’d picked up through Qi Sense.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik’s flushed face looked downright ridiculous.

preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.sol: So did the Level Window I picked up through Qi Sense.

hunks.baseline:
> **System**
> Lv. 24 Kim Sangshik
hunks.sol:
> **System**
>
> **Lv. 24 Kim Sangshik**

hunks.baseline: “Meeting you was disgusting. Let’s never see each other again.”
hunks.sol: “Seeing you again was fucking unpleasant. Let’s never do it again.”

hunks.baseline: I got up without a shred of regret. My waiting number was thirty. The steps I took toward the examiner weren’t stiff anymore.
hunks.sol: I rose without a shred of regret. My waiting number was thirty.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.sol: My steps toward the examiner were no longer stiff.

hunks.baseline: An Awakened with a tense face stood in front of the measuring device. Made from an A-rank Magic Gem, it scanned his whole body and converted the mana inside him into numbers.
hunks.sol: A tense-looking Awakened stood before the measuring device. Made from an A-rank Magic Gem, it scanned his entire body and converted the mana inside him into numbers.

hunks.baseline: The examiner checked the reading and spoke.
hunks.sol: The examiner checked the reading.

hunks.baseline: “Mana distribution in the body: F-rank.”
hunks.sol: “Amount of mana distributed throughout the body: F-rank.”

hunks.baseline: The Awakened’s face turned ashen. But it was too soon to despair. He had a second chance.
hunks.sol: The Awakened’s face turned ashen. But it was too soon to despair. He still had a second chance.

hunks.baseline: “Try moving your mana. Concentrate as hard as you can, and imagine firing it into the measuring device.”
hunks.sol: “Try moving your mana. Concentrate as hard as you can and imagine firing it into the measuring device.”

hunks.baseline: They were checking his mana control. Realizing it wasn’t over yet, the Awakened gritted his teeth and drew up his strength.
hunks.sol: They were testing his mana control. Realizing it wasn’t over yet, the Awakened gritted his teeth and strained with every ounce of strength he had—

hunks.baseline: Every last ounce of it—ngh!
Bwoooom.
hunks.sol: Pfffft.

hunks.baseline: The examiner spoke with a face that looked ready to vomit.
“Control ability: F-rank.”
hunks.sol: Looking ready to vomit, the examiner said, “Control ability: F-rank.”

hunks.baseline: “Just once! Let me try one more time!”
hunks.sol: “Please! Just let me try one more time!”

hunks.baseline: The line moved fast.
hunks.sol: The line moved quickly.

hunks.baseline: All E-rank or F-rank. One guy wasn’t even Awakened.
hunks.sol: Everyone was E-rank or F-rank. One guy wasn’t even Awakened.

hunks.baseline: “Handle him.”
hunks.sol: “Remove him.”

hunks.baseline: At the examiner’s word, the security Hunters waiting nearby dragged the fraud out. Even if that guy miraculously Awakened, he’d probably end up on the Association’s blacklist.
hunks.sol: At the examiner’s command, the security Hunters waiting nearby dragged the fraudster away. Even if that guy miraculously Awakened someday, he’d probably end up on the Association’s blacklist.

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Jin Taekyung, you received F-rank seven years ago… and you know there’s a separate fee for reassessments, right?”
hunks.sol: “Mr. Jin Taekyung, you were rated F-rank seven years ago… You’re aware that reassessments carry a separate fee, correct?”

hunks.baseline: From the way he said it, he might as well have been telling me not to waste my money and to go home while I still could. The usual look people gave an F-rank Hunter.
hunks.sol: From his tone, he might as well have been telling me not to waste my money and to go home while I still could.

hunks.sol: The usual attitude toward an F-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: *Do they think I’m a beggar?*
hunks.sol: *Who does he think he is, treating me like a beggar?*

hunks.baseline: Familiar was one thing. Still filthy was another. When I glared at him, the examiner gave a short puff of a laugh.
hunks.sol: I was used to it. That didn’t make it any less insulting. When I glared at him, the examiner gave a short laugh.

hunks.baseline: “It’s been a few years.”
hunks.sol: “It has been a few years.”

hunks.baseline: “Then we’ll begin the assessment.”
hunks.sol: “Then we’ll begin the measurement.”

hunks.baseline: A wave of mana rolled out of the measuring device and swept through my whole body.
hunks.sol: A wave of magical energy rolled out of the measuring device and swept through my entire body.

hunks.baseline: Fifteen years of internal energy answered it and shuddered.
hunks.sol: My fifteen years of internal energy responded with a shudder.

hunks.baseline: *What rank will it be?*
hunks.sol: *What rank will I get?*

hunks.baseline: C-rank? No, I’d be happy with D-rank. But ten seconds or so passed, and the examiner still didn’t open his mouth.
hunks.sol: C-rank? No, I’d be happy with D-rank. But more than ten seconds passed, and the examiner still said nothing.

hunks.baseline: “Uh… why is it doing this?”
hunks.sol: “Uh… Why is it doing this?”

hunks.baseline: “Why?”
hunks.sol: “What’s wrong?”

hunks.baseline: He looked from the device to me, flustered, then cleared his throat.
hunks.sol: Flustered, he looked back and forth between the device and me, then cleared his throat.

hunks.baseline: I had no idea what was going on, but strangely, it didn’t feel ominous.
hunks.sol: I had no idea what was happening, but strangely, it didn’t feel ominous.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: *This feels good.*
hunks.sol: *I’ve got a good feeling about this.*

hunks.baseline: Feeling my heart pound, I drew up my internal energy.
hunks.sol: My heart pounding, I drew up my internal energy.

hunks.baseline: The lobby entrance.
hunks.sol: At the lobby entrance—

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik patted a young man on the shoulder. As of today, he was a promising young D-rank Awakened, officially recognized.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik patted a young man on the shoulder. As of today, the promising young man had officially been rated D-rank.

hunks.baseline: He would soon join Sopung Guild and be assigned to Kim Sangshik’s team. Thinking of that coming day, Kim Sangshik smiled, proud.
hunks.sol: He would soon join Sopung Guild and be assigned to Kim Sangshik’s team. Thinking of the day to come, Kim Sangshik smiled proudly.

hunks.baseline: “Wait, really? Didn’t you say the Guild didn’t have a spot?”
hunks.sol: “Wait, really? Didn’t you say the Guild didn’t have any openings?”

hunks.baseline: He didn’t mention that, in the process, he’d cut the lowest-rank Hunter who’d been a thorn in his eye.
hunks.sol: He didn’t mention that he’d made room by firing the lowest-ranked Hunter, who had long been a thorn in his side.

hunks.baseline: “Anyway, rest up this week, and starting next week we’ll commute together—”
hunks.sol: “Anyway, get plenty of rest this week. Starting next week, we’ll go to work together—”

hunks.baseline: After his son left, he was alone. He rolled up his shirtsleeve.
hunks.sol: Once his son had left, Kim Sangshik rolled up his shirtsleeve.

hunks.baseline: His wrist had already swollen a dark blue-green. The sight made him grind his teeth.
hunks.sol: His wrist was already swollen blue-black. The sight made him grind his teeth.

hunks.baseline: He’d disliked that bastard from the start. An F-rank Hunter as deputy team leader, and the way he’d been like brothers with the old team leader, who was dead now.
hunks.sol: He’d disliked that bastard from the start. An F-rank Hunter had no business being deputy team leader, and he’d hated the way Taekyung acted like a brother to the former team leader, who was now dead.

hunks.baseline: The unfortunate accident two years ago had been a stroke of luck for Kim Sangshik.
hunks.sol: The unfortunate accident two years ago had been a stroke of extraordinary luck for Kim Sangshik.

hunks.baseline: After being sidelined by various sex scandals, he’d made a triumphant return as team leader. A few days ago, he’d even gotten Jin Taekyung thrown out.
hunks.sol: After being sidelined over several sex scandals, he’d returned triumphantly as team leader. A few days ago, he’d even managed to get Jin Taekyung thrown out.

hunks.baseline: *But was this bastard really a reawakening?*
hunks.sol: *But did that bastard really reawaken?*

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: It had only lasted an instant, but the strength he’d felt then had been tremendous. Taekyung might have reawakened as E-rank—or even D-rank.
hunks.sol: It had lasted only an instant, but the strength he’d felt had been tremendous. Taekyung might have reawakened as an E-rank—or perhaps even a D-rank.

hunks.baseline: “No. Reawakening isn’t child’s play.”
hunks.sol: “No. Reawakening isn’t that easy.”

hunks.baseline: Maybe he’d gotten weaker from not exercising lately. Kim Sangshik was muttering, mixed up inside, when—
hunks.sol: Maybe he’d simply gotten weaker because he hadn’t exercised lately. Kim Sangshik was muttering to himself, his thoughts in turmoil, when—

hunks.baseline: “We have breaking news from the measurement room.”
hunks.sol: “Breaking news from the measurement room.”

hunks.baseline: “Someone good?”
hunks.sol: “Did someone promising show up?”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “They say a big fish surfaced. C-rank.”
hunks.sol: “They say they landed a big fish. C-rank.”

hunks.baseline: “C-rank? Not bad, but that’s not enough to call a big fish, is it?”
hunks.sol: “C-rank? That’s not bad, but is it really enough to call him a big fish?”

hunks.baseline: “But they say his mana control is A-rank.”
hunks.sol: “His mana control is supposedly A-rank.”

hunks.baseline: “What? A-rank! Get a straw in him, now!”
hunks.sol: “What? A-rank? Get your hooks into him, now!”
Nearby, another scout was already on the phone.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. This is Choi Min-su from Sangdong Guild. The thing is—”
hunks.sol: “Yes, this is Choi Minsu from Sangdong Guild. The reason I’m calling is…”

hunks.baseline: A stir spread through the scouts prowling the lobby entrance like hyenas.
hunks.sol: A stir spread among the scouts prowling the lobby entrance like hyenas.

hunks.baseline: Most of them had been sent by small and midsized Guilds, but a few from the major ones were already moving fast.
hunks.sol: Most had been sent by small and midsized Guilds, but the handful representing major Guilds were already moving quickly.

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik’s mind snapped clear. He shoved every thought of Jin Taekyung far away and pulled out his phone.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik’s mind snapped into focus. He cast every thought of Jin Taekyung aside and pulled out his phone.

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik spoke in a rush.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik spoke urgently.

hunks.baseline: “Guild Master, it’s chaos here. A C-rank just showed up. And they say his mana control is at the level of a high-ranking Hunter.”
hunks.sol: “Guild Master, it’s chaos here. A C-rank just appeared, and they say his mana control is on the level of a high-ranking Hunter.”

hunks.baseline: “Exactly. The major Guilds always snatch them up midway, but it looks like they were a step late this time.”
hunks.sol: “Exactly. The major Guilds always snatch them out from under us, but it looks like they were a step late this time.”

hunks.baseline: Rough breaths came through the phone, as if he was excited. Even the way he addressed Kim Sangshik changed.
hunks.sol: Rough breathing came through the phone, as though the Guild Master were excited. Even the way he addressed Kim Sangshik changed.

hunks.baseline: —Sangshik. You hold on to this guy no matter what. Tell him we’ll meet whatever conditions he wants.
hunks.sol: —Sangshik. You hold on to that guy no matter what. Tell him we’ll meet any conditions he wants.

hunks.baseline: “How high can we go on the money?”
hunks.sol: “How high can we go?”

hunks.baseline: —Don’t worry about it. Pile plenty on top of whatever the others offer. The major Guilds will drop out if they decide it isn’t profitable enough. It’s not like they need him.
hunks.sol: —Don’t worry about the money. Add plenty on top of whatever the others offer. The major Guilds will back off if they decide he isn’t profitable enough. It’s not like they’re desperate for him.

hunks.baseline: —I’m on my way. Keep hold of him until I get there. If we pull this off… you know what that means, right?
hunks.sol: —I’m on my way. Keep him there until I arrive. If you pull this off… you know what that means, right?

hunks.baseline: After hanging up, Kim Sangshik clenched his fist.
hunks.sol: After ending the call, Kim Sangshik clenched his fist.

hunks.baseline: *We’ve got this!*
hunks.sol: *We’ve got him!*

hunks.baseline: He’d been worn smooth by years in this business. Holding on to a newly Awakened rookie was nothing.
hunks.sol: He was an old hand at this business. Holding on to a newly Awakened rookie would be easy.

hunks.baseline: This was a world where money could put even ghosts to work.
hunks.sol: Money could make even ghosts work.

hunks.baseline: *Twice what everyone else offers. I’ll quote double, no matter what.*
hunks.sol: *Double whatever everyone else offers. I’ll offer him twice as much, no matter what.*

hunks.baseline: The commotion grew louder. The elevator that had stopped on the third floor, where the measurement room was, was coming down toward the lobby.
hunks.sol: The commotion grew louder. The elevator was descending from the third floor, where the measurement room was located.

hunks.baseline: “Hey, stop shoving.”
hunks.sol: “Hey, stop shoving!”

hunks.baseline: About twenty scouts clung to the entrance like a swarm of ants. Kim Sangshik had muscled his way into the lead and was ready to hand over his card.
hunks.sol: Some twenty scouts crowded around the elevator doors like a swarm of ants. Kim Sangshik muscled his way to the front and readied his business card.

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik bowed low and launched into the words he’d prepared.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik bowed low and launched into his prepared speech.

hunks.baseline: “Hello. I’m Team Leader Kim Sangshik of Sopung Guild. We’re a prestigious Guild with a long tradition here in Bucheon—”
hunks.sol: “Hello. I’m Team Leader Kim Sangshik of Sopung Guild. We are a prestigious Guild with a long tradition here in Bucheon—”

hunks.baseline: “This is the first time I’ve heard anyone call Sopung a prestigious Guild.”
hunks.sol: “That’s the first time I’ve ever heard anyone call Sopung a prestigious Guild.”

hunks.baseline: The familiar voice made Kim Sangshik lift his head, gingerly.
hunks.sol: At the familiar voice, Kim Sangshik slowly raised his head.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, Kim Sangshik’s buttonhole-sized eyes went wide.
hunks.sol: At the same moment, Kim Sangshik’s buttonhole-sized eyes flew wide.

hunks.baseline: “You, you…”
hunks.sol: “Y-you…”
